thread:
Evelyn: Heads up team   we need to avoid confusing customers with mixed "available" flags across regions for the upcoming HW waves (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). Quick sync?
Diego: +1. SI labs flagged a potential driver rollback for Gaudi in APAC; could be a 1-2 week hit.
Sofia: Marketing POV: if APAC slips we must not list "global availability" on the marketplace card. Use region badges instead.
Noah: Ops: can we gate SKU flips by SI cert boolean? We already support region feature flags but need a clean process to flip them post-cert.
Evelyn: Suggestion: three-state rollout per SKU: private-canary -> staged-region -> public. Only public after SI cert + 48h canary.
Diego: SI action: we'll publish per-region cert dates tomorrow AM. If Gaudi needs rollback, we recommend hold on public listing until a post-rollback stability window (7d).
Sofia: Comms: draft embargo templates for "staged" vs "public" announcements. Also include recommended language for partners to avoid mis-synced press.
InfraBot: Note: created ticket PART-2201 to reserve a 2x GPU canary pool in APAC and 1x in EU.
Noah: Runtime note: prepare runtime fallback to B200-quantized variants when H100 latency SLOs spike; add telemetry tag "fallback:quant".
Evelyn: Also propose a small "beta" SKU in Console for MI300 EU if perf is borderline; opt-in only. That reduces support noise.
Diego: We'll also push a driver smoke matrix for MI300 microbenchmarks. Anything >10% regression = block for public.
Sofia: Approve embargo plan: if any region is blocked we will postpone press in that region and consolidate global press to next wave. Legal wants explicit "region-limited" clause.
Noah: Ops to do: implement flip playbook, add a rollback runbook linked in PART-2201.
Evelyn: Action items:
- Diego -> per-region cert dates + driver matrix (tomorrow AM)
- Noah -> flip playbook + rollback runbook (EOD)
- Sofia -> embargo templates + partner comms copy (EOD)
- InfraBot -> confirm canary capacity allocation (now)
Diego: tagging @partner-ops for firmware call if we need cross-vendor coordination.
Sofia: I'll update the marketplace card copy to include region badges and a small tooltip: "Availability subject to SI certification."
Evelyn: Thanks. If Gaudi patch arrives sooner we can shorten the canary window; otherwise proceed with three-state rollout. Ping me on any blockers.
